comment: detect.c find_trap() clears the map, shows the trap, prints 'You find ...', and then waits through display_nhwindow(WIN_MAP, TRUE) when the trap's glyph is hidden under an object. With MSGTYPE=hide matching every message, the topline stays empty, so tty_display_nhwindow() has no --More-- to wait for and find_trap() goes straight to docrt(). A human Samurai in debug mode steps off the up stairs, wishes for a squeaky board there, drops the ya on it, steps away, and searches with a count until the board is found. The seed and date were chosen arbitrarily; the search count leaves room for rnl(8).
